test_title: PYST 34: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only. (All numbers are single-digit numbers only.)

(Left) 5 7 1 8 4 2 3 9 5 7 6 1 (Right)

How many even numbers are there (from left to right) which are immediately followed by odd numbers?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 5 7 1 8 4 2 3 9 5 7 6 1 (Right)

Now,

Even numbers which are immediately followed by odd numbers.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a85c26e9679542ed2bc8dbddcd366cf99019492773b0d11f0489059b60de96e.png] 

Thus, there are two even numbers, each of which are immediately followed by odd numbers.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
